test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d810668760b9e8bbe2d11dc9fcc30883401d612f8daab2e6048365aced00b5d7.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left, and bottom-right element are interchanging their position.

All 3 horizontal elements are shifting in a clockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Left 2(Top left and middle left) and right 2(bottom right and Middle right) symbols are interchanging their position respectively.

Middle symbol is replaced by a new symbol.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/339918ea8efdd9992f127bff76e871e3a8889b0d5b7d61ecbab770b7aa9cd16a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
